notes.title: Thanks for 1500+ Downloads!
notes.content:
[h2] [b]Thanks for 1500+ Downloads![/b] [/h2][p][b]  Hello there![/b][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45664397/e8aeeb49c19919fc8a6d338aeef81d5370852aa5.png"][/img][/p][p]Reaching over 1500 players with [i]Scary Game[/i] is an incredible milestone for me.
I'm truly grateful to everyone who played, laughed, screamed, refunded, or recommended the game. ❤️[/p][p]I've read all of your comments one by one. I took note of the missing features you pointed out — especially the lack of a settings menu and the short playtime, which understandably frustrated some players.[/p][p]I’m aware of these shortcomings and fully committed to improving them in my next game.
A longer, weirder, more intense, and even more absurd experience is already in the works![/p][p]💬 If there’s anything you’d like to see in the sequel, please leave a comment and let me know.
Your feedback means a lot, and I want to shape the next game together with you![/p][p]Thank you!
— [b]KANGAMES[/b] 🧠🩸[/p]
